prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: original eight-frame pixel-art spellcasting sprite sheet for Elowen's Last Stand. Reference image1 is exact character identity, equipment, and shield-block stance reference. Create NEW action: Elowen lifts her kite shield as if blocking, magical frost progressively covers the shield, she braces and projects an ice beam from its face, then recovers. Layout EXACT 4 columns x2rows, eight full-body poses read left-to-right top-to-bottom, 2048x1024 transparent canvas with512x512 cells. All face RIGHT, no turns. Character: adult blonde female elf, pointed ears, blue eyes/jewels, ornate silver armour gold trim, flowing navy blue gold embroidered tabard/cloak, same large navy blue/gold kite shield and FULL-LENGTH silver sword. Keep original adult proportions, detailed sharp pixel-art texture, face/hair/armour colours, sword length in EVERY pose. Sword remains clearly visible lowered forward in her right hand, shield in left. Stable grounded feet and body/pelvis x256, head-to-boot height~400pixels, baseline y472, all equipment within each cell's transparent margins. Eight chronological poses: 1 starts lifting normal unfrosted shield; 2 shield rises to defensive blocking height, thin white frost creeps around blue/gold rim; 3 firmly braced blocking stance, branching pale blue/white ice crystals spread over half the shield's face; 4 RELEASE POSE: shield held out ahead of chest facing right, its face fully coated with bright translucent blue-white ice with the original gold crest faintly visible through ice, a SMALL white-blue light at centre/right edge of shield; 5 firm firing hold, shield fully frosted and luminous, arm recoil subtle, feet planted; 6 second firing hold with subtle ice crackle variation and cloak followthrough; 7 glow fades and small frozen chips shed from shield while it lowers; 8 return to ordinary ready stance, remaining frost melts away, blue/gold original shield restored. Crucial: effects confined to shield, entire body NOT tinted blue. DO NOT draw the beam itself or long external projectile; engine supplies beam as a separate animated effect extending screen right from shield centre. No floating orb or magic circle. No extra shields/limbs, no sword attack, no shortened sword. True transparent alpha=0 between all figures and limbs, opaque character interiors. No floor, shadows, scenery, gradient, halo background, text, labels or grid. Crisp consistent sprite silhouette and same body scale every frame.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact eight-pose 4x2 Elowen ice shield sprite sheet. Remove ONLY the off-white backdrop, background texture/noise, ground shadows and broad ambient haze around the figures. Preserve all eight characters, original identity, equipment, full sword lengths, shield frost branching and small bright frozen shield-centre points, pose shapes and exact cell layout/dimensions. Produce a real transparent PNG with alpha=0 in ALL empty space between/around figures and limbs. Solid character pixels must remain opaque alpha255, naturally antialiased silhouette edges only. Preserve pale ice on the shields and the few distinct shedding ice chips in pose7; remove background haze between cells. No red/yellow cleanup marks or outlines, no replacement floor/shadow/checkerboard. Keep eight whole characters and equipment unchanged. This is for direct overlay on a dark game scene, so absolutely no white rectangle or translucent backdrop may remain.
